text:
maria: Quick thread 13: proposing a small long-haul refactor: peel tenant-specific cache and routing out of the monolithic session-sidecar into an "isolation adapter" per-tenant cohort. Purpose: reduce global contention and make per-tenant budgets explicit. Want quick sanity checks before an RFC.

jon: Can you sketch cutover steps?

maria: Sure: 1) instrumentation + shadow adapters (no traffic change); 2) read-shadow at 0.1% traffic; 3) sticky-route cohorts (reads prefer adapter, session-core fallback); 4) authoritative read cutover; 5) prune legacy code. Each phase gated.

kevin: What's the expected perf delta? extra network hop vs lock removal?

maria: Expect p50 +~1ms on cold path, p95 improvements under load due to removed lock contention and less GC. We'll measure during shadow runs.

sara: How do we handle shared-lookups (cross-tenant joins)?

maria: Cross-tenant joins remain in session-core; adapters expose a small fetch API with consistent read-before-write semantics. For joins we route to session-core to avoid distributed consistency issues.

ops-bot: /cohort create tenant-isolate-1  cohort created (temp id: ti-176660)

jon: Rollout and rollback triggers?

maria: Gate on p95 latency, user-facing error rate, cache_miss_ratio, and eval quality. Rollback if p95 > +10% or errors > +1% absolute. Also monitor memory pressure per adapter.

kevin: Ops surface increase concerns. How to avoid explosion of knobs?
maria: One binary, same observability stack, feature flags for budgets. We'll default to small memory caps and soft alerts. Only tenants above a threshold get dedicated adapters initially.

sara: DB/schema impact?
maria: None. Keys get tenant-prefixed during cutover; adapters use same backend stores. We'll provide a migration tool for dry-run.

kevin: Tests? staging plan?
maria: Staging replay with 1x/3x traffic; unit tests for adapter shim; chaos injection for partial failures. Canary plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

jon: Who owns the RFC and timeline?
maria: @kevin to draft RFC by next Wed, @sara to add eviction/cost sections, @jon to add runbook. I'll run perf replays and post results here.

ops-bot: canary scheduled for 02:00 UTC tomorrow (canary id: can-176660)

kevin: Starting draft today. Will include cost model and cutover playbook.

sara: I'll prototype eviction policy and default budgets this week.

maria: Action list:
- kevin: RFC + cost sheet (Wed)
- sara: eviction + budgets (Fri)
- jon: runbook + rollback cmds (Tue)
- maria: perf replay + initial metrics in this thread (Mon)

kevin: :+1: will tag arch-reviewers when ready.

maria: Thanks all — this is intended to be incremental (one small peel per sprint), not a big-bang.
